DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PUR-
SUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE
WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO
REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED
FORCES FROM LEBANON
The SPEAKER pro tempore. Pursu-
ant to clause 8 of rule XX, the unfin-
ished business is the vote on adoption
of the concurrent resolution (H. Con.
Res. 84) directing the President pursu-
ant to section 5(c) of the War Powers
Resolution to remove United States
Armed Forces from Lebanon, on which
the yeas and nays were ordered.
The Clerk read the title of the con-
current resolution.
The SPEAKER pro tempore. The
question is on adoption of the concur-
rent resolution.
The vote was taken by electronic de-
vice, and there were—yeas 92, nays 324,
answered ‘‘present’’ 2, not voting 12, as
follows:
[Roll No. 201]


So the resolution was not agreed to.
The result of the vote was announced
as above recorded.
A motion to reconsider was laid on
the table.
